channel.title: Honolulu Crash Feed
channel.description: Publicly reported traffic crashes on Oahu with source credits. Aggregated for awareness — not an official HPD product.

item.title: Serious hit-and-run on Farrington Highway in Waianae
item.description: An unidentified westbound motorist struck a 57-year-old female pedestrian near Waianae Valley Road and fled without stopping. The pedestrian was taken to an area hospital in serious condition. HPD Vehicular Homicide Section is investigating. Source credit: HPD Traffic Division, Vehicular Homicide Section.

item.title: Critical collision in private driveway on Waimano Home Road
item.description: A 45-year-old female motorist turning left into a private driveway on Waimano Home Road collided with a 30-year-old female motorist exiting the driveway. The 45-year-old was taken to an area hospital in critical condition; the other motorist was not injured. Speed does not appear to be a factor. HPD Vehicular Homicide Section is investigating. Source credit: Honolulu Police Department.

item.title: H-1 eastbound dump truck lodged under Waiawa overpass
item.description: A dump truck traveling east on the H-1 Freeway struck the Waiawa overpass around 1:08 p.m., lodging its trailer under the bridge. Another vehicle struck debris. No injuries reported. Lanes reopened by about 4:30 p.m. after heavy eastbound gridlock near the H-1/H-2 merge. Source credit: Photo/video: Moesolo Upuese Tagovailoa, HPD advisory, @DOTHawaii traffic update.

item.title: Pedestrian seriously injured by motorcycle on University Avenue
item.description: A 22-year-old female pedestrian was struck by a motorcycle while crossing at University Avenue and South King Street. Honolulu EMS treated her on scene and continued care en route for serious trauma, including facial injuries. Source credit: Honolulu EMS.

item.title: Two seriously injured in Kaneohe Bay Drive rollover
item.description: A 21-year-old male driver and 21-year-old male passenger sustained serious injuries in a single-vehicle rollover. Honolulu EMS responded with multiple units to the 190–298 block of Kaneohe Bay Drive and transported both to local emergency rooms. Source credit: Ancheta, Dillon | HNN.

item.title: Pickup rollover at Kahekili and Likelike highways
item.description: A 23-year-old male pickup truck driver was hospitalized in serious condition after striking a highway median and rolling onto its top near Kahekili Highway and Likelike Highway. Honolulu EMS treated the driver for multiple injuries around 10:15 p.m. Source credit: HNN Staff.

item.title: Fatal rollover on Bingham Street in McCully
item.description: A vehicle carrying four occupants sideswiped a parked car on Bingham Street near McCully around 11:50 p.m., overturned, and struck a fire hydrant. The 26-year-old driver later died; a 25-year-old passenger was critically injured. HFD extricated two occupants. Oahu’s 26th traffic fatality of 2026. Source credit: HNN Staff, Photo: Honolulu EMS, Island News, HFD incident release.

item.title: Critical moped collision at Fort Weaver Road, Ewa Beach
item.description: A 57-year-old male moped operator turning left from Renton Road against a red signal was struck by a 29-year-old male motorist on Fort Weaver Road. The moped operator was ejected and taken to an area hospital in critical condition; he was not wearing a helmet. The motorist was not injured. Source credit: Honolulu Police Department.
